title: Scalar multiplication of Hermite coefficients
statement: For any dimension $n$, real scalar $c$, function $f:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$, and multi-index $\alpha\in\mathbb N^n$, the Hermite coefficient of $cf$ at $\alpha$ equals $c$ times the Hermite coefficient of $f$ at $\alpha$.
